details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $|\mathcal H|\geq\mathrm{Edim}(\mathcal H)+1$.
proof: The base hypothesis cannot serve as a witness. Moreover a witness hypothesis used at step i agrees with the base on all earlier points but differs at x_i, so it cannot have been used at an earlier step. Thus there are d+1 distinct hypotheses.
witness_verification: For the $n$-dimensional full cube, size is $2^n$ whereas combinatorial eluder dimension is $n$.
name: Size / Combinatorial Eluder Dimension (affine)
